docket_entries.description: THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF ANDREA WRIGHT IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SHANNON BULLERI IS PRESENT. THE COURT DID NOT CONSIDER THE PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AND HEREBY DISMISSES THIS MATTER FOR LACK OF JURISDICTION DUE TO PLAINTIFFS FAILURE TO FILE A TORT CLAIM AGAINST THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO GOVERNMENT CODE 945.4. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CECILIA P. CASTELLANOS; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. (506)
